operation.body:
### Goal

Close **FR-007** by confirming meaningful automated coverage for submission, validation, categorization, category filtering, and persistence at appropriate boundaries, and add only the integration gaps still missing on `main`.

### Acceptance criteria

- Integration test proves a valid submission without an explicit category is stored as `other` (HTTP boundary, not only model unit test).
- Existing integration tests for FR-001–FR-006 remain green; do not remove or broadly refactor the suite.
- Run `bin/rails test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement FR-008 sample dataset, README/demo finalization pass, or edits to `docs/security-review.md`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, documentation churn beyond what FR-007 strictly requires, and broad test-suite rewrites.

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-006 behaviour and integration tests are on `main` (goals #12, #14, #16, #18, #20, #22; PRs #13, #15, #17, #19, #21, #23). Model test already defaults category to `other`; FR-007 needs the submission path covered at integration level. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-007.

<!-- project-executor:goal project=szymoniwacz/feedback-inbox#2 -->
operation.title: [Agent Goal]: Meaningful test coverage (FR-007)
